services.desc: Experience world-class fishing charters in Alaska with a certified guide who brings 50 years of expertise, unmatched safety credentials, and a warm, educational approach for anglers of all ages and skill levels. Step into the heart of wild Alaska with personalized fishing charters designed for both seasoned anglers and first-timers. D Ray Personal Guide Service specializes in guided fishing adventures on the legendary Kenai River, as well as select rivers across the Kenai Peninsula and Mat-Su Borough.
